question: When the people of Gaza waited to kill Samson at the city gate, what did he do in the middle of the night?
options: He climbed over the city wall
He fought all the guards at the gate
He tore loose the doors of the city gate with the two posts and carried them away
explanation: Samson got up in the middle of the night, tore loose the doors of the city gate with the two posts, bar and all, and carried them on his shoulders.
